title: Walmart Shoplifter's Getaway Plan Falls Apart in Seconds
description:
#news #police #arrest

On November 19th, 2025. Officers were called to a retail theft in progress at a Walmart. Store employees reported a man in an electronics section who matched the description of a theft suspect.
Officers located the individual inside the store, and police said the suspect fled out the store and into a car waiting in the parking lot, driven by another suspect. The suspects fled and a brief police pursuit was quickly cancelled due to safety concerns, officers said. The vehicle later crashed on the. The suspects fled on foot but were arrested without further incident, according to police. This is body-cam footage of the events.
